_note: Intro Nokon timings, in seconds unless the key says otherwise; angles in degrees.

opening._note: The closed curtain waits wait_s, splits open over curtain_s, then the menu waits post_open_s. The chosen button flashes (one way over flash_half_s); the light turns once every light_turn_s; every jiggle_delay_s plus up to jiggle_delay_spread_s (random) the logo rocks by jiggle_deg over jiggle_s.

setup._note: A roll's item zooms over zoom_s; Go flashes (one way over go_flash_half_s); an error shows for error_s.

game._note: The genre shows this long before its song starts.

dialogue._note: Nokon slides in and out over slide_s; the text types chars_per_s letters a second.
